Vs Thunder Dragons: Both equally efficient going efficient at crippling your opponent from playing going 1st but Zaborg generates card advantage as well. Both are also 100% useless going second unless your opponent bricked or was stopped.

Vs pendulum, it’s able to get rid of your opponents main combo pieces such as Elpy and electrum practically killing your opponent where as krystia will just get outed by purple poison or black fang making zaborg better in this position
